criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Medeo documents URL media import and product-video workflows, but no AIVP artifact proves exact-ASIN preservation in the first ten seconds.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Vendor demos and publish-ready claims are not hands-on AIVP evidence.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Editor and workflow controls are documented, but repeatability and product drift require saved runs.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: Official pages document a differentiated trend-to-research-to-production-to-publishing loop; actual time savings and trend accuracy are untested.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: No AIVP timing, queue, failure-rate or recovery artifacts.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: A free plan and model credit rates are published, but VideoClaw inclusion and cost per accepted output are not established.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Terms grant a worldwide lawful-use licence for complete outputs, but it is revocable and third-party elements/media permissions need clarification.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Official OpenAPI documentation covers media import, recipes, video creation, rendering and polling, and links an OpenClaw-compatible skill; VideoClaw-specific endpoint scope still belongs in workflow unknowns.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Browser product and USD free tier target creators/SMBs globally; Australian payments, support and data-locality details are unverified.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: The use case has transactional creator intent, but no affiliate programme or tracking was found.

analysis: VideoClaw's documented trend-to-production loop is relevant and differentiated, with a practical API and explicit but qualified output-use rights. Exact trend accuracy, output quality, repeatability, speed, cost and product identity are untested, so the credible label is Monitor only at confidence C.
confidence_notes: Primary vendor announcement, product, pricing, legal and API documents only; no AIVP run.

hard_gates.publication: Blocked pending hands-on evidence and launch-media/third-party rights clarification.
hard_gates.integration: Not started; API key/account permissions, egress and cost gates require audit before use.
